info.title: deposit.now x402 Deposit API
info.description: Public x402 API for AI agents to autonomously deposit funds. Pay 0.01 USDC per call over HTTP via the x402 protocol (v2, exact scheme) on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). No accounts or API keys required.
info.x-guidance: Use POST /api/deposit to trigger a deposit for an agent account. Send a JSON body with optional 'amount' (decimal string) and 'account' (agent identifier). Unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment requirements in the Payment-Required header; pay 0.01 USDC on Base mainnet with any x402 client (e.g. @x402/fetch for JavaScript, x402[httpx] for Python) and retry with the X-Payment header. Docs: https://deposit.now/docs

post.summary: Trigger a deposit for an AI agent account

amount.description: Deposit amount to trigger, as a decimal string. Defaults to 100.00.

account.description: Agent account identifier receiving the deposit. Defaults to default-agent.

200.description: Deposit triggered. Includes an X-Payment-Response header with the x402 settlement receipt.

402.description: Payment required. The Payment-Required response header contains base64-encoded x402 v2 payment requirements (scheme exact, network Base mainnet eip155:8453, asset USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, amount 10000 atomic units).
